scope: Independent canonicality, duplicate/wrapper and compressed-spine audit of all 59 original production declarations. No edits or remote actions. Does not replace accepted reader v3 or rendered acceptance.

reachability.edge_semantics: Graph export lists consumer->dependency constant occurrence. Closure here uses VALUE edges among selected named nodes, not source entailment.
reachability.private_limit: vectorConsEquiv source use is manually verified in sum_vectors_succ; not exported as a named node, so no claim all59 are graph nodes.
reachability.prefixMeasure_limit: No selected VALUE consumers, but two TYPE consumers. Unfolding can remove the named alias from proof VALUE. Zero VALUE use is not alone dead-code evidence.

standalone_interface_decision.classification: Retained route-local representation adapters over an existing canonical shared finite-law API. Not a newly canonical generic foundation, terminal necessity, established reused interface or mathematical advance.
standalone_interface_decision.mathematical_value: Provides one named probability measure for the exact recursive law and an exact equality transporting arbitrary real finite-path expectations to its integral. All mathematical premises are discharged from actual normalization/nonnegativity.
standalone_interface_decision.existing_canonical_owner: BanditRLProof.Exp3.finiteActionMeasure plus probability/integral theorems in main Exp3ConditionalMoments.lean. The route does not duplicate their measure construction or proofs.
standalone_interface_decision.actual_consumers: prefix_distribution is consumed by the probability/integral adapter proofs; prefixMeasure is used in their types. No selected application uses either exported bridge theorem. No external consumer was established in this audit.
standalone_interface_decision.why_not_delete_now: The three requested objects and packaging theorem form a coherent exact original API boundary, preserve original scope, and do not masquerade as required lower-proof steps. Thin adapters are acceptable as explicit retained API compatibility, with zero extra source-completion/reuse credit.

searches: Main BanditRLProof all .lean for target binary-history APIs, List.Vector Bool, List Bool -> real, square-loss theorem names.
OnlineLearning/Exp3 modules for variance, expected-square and bounded-square interfaces.
FTLState prefix names compared with generic history-policy causality.
reuse_search.conclusion: No same-contract current-main duplicate for the custom binary path/moment/seeded terminal family found in bounded search. Existing generic mean, regret and finite-action measure APIs are already reused. Similar IID variance or fixed-FTL prefix lemmas are not interchangeable contracts.
reuse_search.limit: Bounded semantic/name search, not an exhaustive extensional-equivalence decision procedure.

duplicate_wrapper_findings.disposition: Retain: used rewriting boundaries remove repeated unfolding across several substantive consumers. Do not present bookkeeping as independent source results.

duplicate_wrapper_findings.disposition: Retain as explicit same-path feasibility/minimum bridge and actual integrability-bound dependency; no duplicated mean proof.
